note: lap 10 pre-check (no model call). Per request: the rules it states (one behaviour a scenario can check) and the pairs of rules the request text ties together (one rule's sentence uses the other's outcome: 'the same rule', 'goes first to', 'as of', 'frozen at', a quantity the other defines), each with the reason. Counted by the author for the calibration requests (lap 9's strict versions, all at the ceiling after the rescore) and the candidates alike. A candidate passes when its pair count is at least pairsTimes x the largest calibration count. Rules: laps/lap-10/runbook.md.
